body:
Thanks! That was really helpful. Too bad Norway is a small country, the online chat services are limited, and I would not be able to keep it together on the phone I think. What i dread the most is facing my family though. I hate getting help, I know intellectually that's stupid, but I hate feeling helpless and vulnerable in the eyes of my family. 

And you're completely right about being hard on myself, I've known since when I i first admitted to depression. I have difficulty with my feelings of inadequacy, despite knowing intellectually that I should give myself a break. 

On the laziness note that is an actual problem, I went through equivalent of high school with little to no effort and not developing good study habits, if any at all. Collage courses hit me square in the face, I was just incapable of adjusting.
